new-and-changed-responsibilities.text: The tool rewrites and self-checks, the test proves it twice over with a planted stray, the recipe wires it into docs checks. The flowchart shows tool to tree to test to recipe to checks.

dependency-direction.text: The tool rewrites the tree, the test drives the tool, the recipe wires the test. Nothing feeds back into product code.

promotion.text: No new shared modules. The derived rule lives in the tool; the twice-run discipline lives in its test.
